sources.provider: UCLA Geoportal · North America Telephone Area Code Boundaries, 14 October 2015, preserved by 1ec5

coverage: All in-service geographic US NANP codes, including the five inhabited territories. Non-geographic US and shared NANP services are listed separately and have no polygon. Assigned future codes are not shown as active.
geometry: Generalized public-domain UCLA 2015 reference footprints, clipped to Census 2025 state land and reconciled with NANPA 17 October 2026 assignments. New overlays use their parent footprint; multiple and partial overlays retain separate coverage. Los Angeles 213/323 and Phoenix 480/602/623 boundary eliminations are dissolved. These are reference areas, not address-level telephone-service guarantees. Later small rate-center boundary adjustments may not be reflected.
